common_assumptions: File contents have not changed since last read within the same session
Truncated tool output (head -N lines) represents the complete picture
TypeScript noEmit compile success equals feature working correctly at runtime
Previous session process state and port ownership are still valid without re-verification
A single narrow-scope grep confirms global absence of a pattern or module
strength_patterns: Iterative diagnostic approach: writes and runs probe scripts to isolate unknowns before applying fixes rather than guessing
Reads existing code structure before modifying and references specific file targets in tool calls
Constructs structured verification scripts that emit explicit PASS/FAIL/ALL-MATCH signals
weakness_patterns: High-step chains exhibit strong fixation: same file edited 20-60+ times in a single chain (e.g. +page.svelte, statusline.sh, generate-html.ts) without stepping back to rethink the strategy
Thinking steps appear in only 4 of 30 chains; most chains jump directly to tool use with no explicit reasoning phase, treating first-read output as sufficient to act on
Verification is frequently substituted with compile-only checks (tsc --noEmit, --collect-only) or truncated output, then progress is declared without exercising the actual code path
